all_pool_assumption_audit.scoring_scope: post-decision only; never supplied to the rule

costs.agent: B3 carries the actual two-query episode forward; no third action or third-query saving is manufactured
costs.excluded: model calls/tokens, human relay, host inference/refit and future protocol overhead; no total-cost claim
costs.overlapping_timers: evaluation and outer-operation durations are separate and must not be added
costs.scope: sums of recorded candidate evaluation durations; counterfactual skipped costs, not newly saved wall time

full_pool_collection.scope: full-pool corpus/oracle collection; costs all twelve measured attempts, irrespective of replay budget

limitations: Rule was motivated after seeing this completed study; all diagnostics are retrospective.
One related-domain workload and five dependent seeds cannot establish generalization or policy superiority.
An analytic estimate is not an unconditional bound; an unseen positive residual can make stopping miss an improvement.
The archived source policies and original fixed-budget reports remain unchanged.
This does not evaluate changed query orders or use target outcomes for fitting.
Future use requires a new source-bound preregistration and prospective release.

rule.condition: paid feasible incumbent saved cycles >= max(0, every unattempted frozen estimated saved cycles)
rule.guarantee: conditional on unmeasured candidates not exceeding the public analytic estimates; not a proved hardware bound
rule.numerical_comparison: cycle units with no speedup rounding or tolerance
rule.objective: whole-program cycle benefit; equal-speedup area/timing tie improvements are outside the stopping objective
rule.observed_paid_mismatch: disable stopping after any measured-versus-estimated benefit mismatch
rule.remaining_scope: entire twelve-candidate roster, not just remaining actions in the archived order
